evidence.summary: The user describes Subscribe as monthly subscriptions that create orders

features.name: Renew a subscription into an order
features.description: Each renewal of a subscription creates an order for the subscription's customer and price
features.observed_behaviour: renew() calls the injected create_order(customer, price) once per call and returns its result
features.business_logic: No period or duplicate check: calling renew twice for the same month creates two orders. The monthly schedule is documented by the user but there is no scheduler in the code.
features.integration: needs an order-creation function from the host app

entities.name: Subscription
entities.description: A customer's recurring plan: who pays and how much per renewal (an in-memory dict)

fields.name: customer
fields.description: passed to create_order as the order's customer

fields.name: price
fields.description: passed to create_order as the order amount; unit not stated

architecture.backend: one function with an injected order factory

unknowns: How and when renew() is triggered monthly: no scheduler in the code (task.md says monthly)
Whether a subscription has an id, a status or a billing period: none in the code
Rights: task.md states no rights and there is no licence file, so code_reuse is unknown and nothing is copied
